services.value: WETLAB provides water, soil, and hazardous waste analysis, including microbiology, general chemistry, metals, organics, priority pollutants, TCLP compounds, and mine waste characterization. The Las Vegas satellite lab provides limited in-demand services including microbiology (e.g., E. coli, total coliforms, fecal coliforms, temperature, and odor) and wet-chemistry analysis (pH, Orthophosphate, Dissolved Oxygen, Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD), and Carbonaceous BOD (CBOD)).
